book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: Preya blanga meigim pipul jidan raitwei

content.text: YAWEI, mi prei langa yu.
Lisin langa main preya.
Kaman kwikbala blanga album mi.
Jinggabat main preya jis laik im gudsmelwan medisin langa yu.
Wen mi lidimap main bingga blanga prei langa yu,
jinggabat tharran deya wulijim speshalwan ofring blanga yu.
YAWEI, holdim main mawus,
en nomo larram mi tok nogudwei.
Nomo larram mi blanga wandi jinggabat blanga dum nogudwan ting.
Nomo larram mi weistimbat taim dumbat nogud ting garram ola nogudwan pipul.
Nomo larram mi joinin en dagat daga brom detlot nogudbala pipul.
Wen detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei langa yu streitinimap mi,
en panishim mi garram det raitwei blanga yu,
ai garra larram olabat.
Mi oldei prei blanga stapam ola nogudwan ting weya ola nogudbala pipul oldei dumbat.
Wen YAWEI garra tjakamdan ola big bosmob brom det haiwan rok,
ola nogudbala pipul garra sabi tharran main wed bin trubalawan orait.
Blanga olabat boun garra leidan ebriweya langa greibyad,
jis laik ola ston weya sambodi bin smeshimap.
YAWEI, ai luk langa yu.
Yu main boswan God.
Mi kaman langa yu blanga kipum mi seif.
Nomo larram enijing kaman en ardim mi.
Maindimbat mi brom detlot nogudbala pipul hu wandi trepam mi garram ola nogud ting.
Meigim olabat buldan langa olabat ron trep weya olabat bin pudum,
en seimtaim album mi blanga gidawei seifwan.
